== Course of events ==

After General Jinjur was captured in the palace courtyard and her refusal to surrender had already hardened into open war against Glinda and Ozma, the collapse of her cause was completed by revelations concerning the throne she had seized. Old Mombi confessed, and it was revealed that Tip was truly Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler the Emerald City had been waiting for. For Queen Jinjur, who had built her claim to power on holding the throne she occupied, the confession stripped away any remaining legitimacy her rule might have had, and she fell into despair on learning what Mombi had admitted and who Tip really was.

The revelation reached General Jinjur, Old Mombi, Tip, and the Queen at a moment when Jinjur's position had already been broken by capture, leaving her with no army in the field and no way to answer this new blow. With Tip now known as Princess Ozma, the rightful heir stood revealed before the very court Jinjur had claimed to rule, and the despair that followed marked the end of any hope Jinjur might have held of retaining her crown.

This moment of confession and despair cleared the way for what came next: the Army of Revolt surrendered, the stolen jewels were returned, and Ozma was crowned queen of the Emerald City, the throne passing at last to the one Mombi's confession had shown to be its true and rightful holder.
